proved_reduction: The full pure multiplier-one peripheral outer centralizer of the geometric twelve-cusp A5 action is canonically isomorphic to GT0^1 through E=C2 coproduct C3. The residual completed geometric centralizer is exactly the intersection of this image with the completed pure mapping class group. Retaining three labelled cusps gives 220 actual outer homomorphisms GT0^1 -> P^1 of rank-two free profinite groups; their joint kernel reduces to five specified kernels by exact A5 equivariance.
